title: Slipway front matter: shared keys
description: The keys every page may set (ADR 0003, decision 2). Unknown keys are kept and ignored, never rejected. The layout schemas build on this one.

canonical_url.description: The original URL of the page, if it was first published elsewhere.

categories.description: Categories: a list, or one space-separated string as Jekyll allows.

description.description: One sentence for search results and link previews.

dir.description: Text direction (ADR 0003). Defaults to the direction of `lang`.

direction.description: Text direction as the base layout reads it today; same meaning as `dir`.

image.description: The page's own social image (`og:image`): a path on this site or an https link. Without it, Actions mode generates one from the title, and every mode falls back to the shared `assets/images/social.png`.

lang.description: BCP 47 language tag, for example `en`, `fa`, or `pt-BR`. Defaults to the site language.

layout.description: The layout that renders the page. Picks the schema in schema/front-matter/README.md.

permalink.description: The output URL: a path starting with `/`, or one of Jekyll's built-in styles.

published.description: `false` leaves the page out of the build.

replaced_by.description: The URL of the page that replaces this one, if deprecated.

review_date.description: The date this page was last reviewed.

search.description: `false` leaves the page out of the search index.

since.description: The version when the page status was set.

sitemap.description: `false` leaves the page out of sitemap.xml.

status.description: The page status; ADR records also accept proposed, accepted, rejected, and superseded.

tags.description: Tags: a list, or one space-separated string as Jekyll allows.

title.description: The page title, used in the heading, the tab, and feeds.

translation_key.description: Links the translations of one page; pages with the same key are alternates of each other.

updated.description: The date the page was last substantially edited. A post shows it as "edited on" after its publish date, and feeds, the sitemap, and structured data use it as the last-modified date.

width.description: Page width: `narrow` (34rem), `wide` (64rem), or `full` (the whole window). Leave it out for the reading width. Inside any width, wrap a section in `.sl-wide` or `.sl-bleed` to widen it.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, optionally with a time and a UTC offset (`2026-10-18 09:30:00 +0330`).

url.description: A path on this site or an https link.
